variables.label: BJP vote share
variables.note: Unit values are the official ECI results; hexagons are modelled. ACs with incomplete booth data have complete official AC values
variables.caveat: Modelled from booth results spread over where voters live (method: booth catchments on the 100 m population grid). Shares of valid votes incl. NOTA, EVM + postal. Grey: AC booth data incomplete.
